description:
Audit an HTML document or fragment against a WCAG 2.1 A/AA static ruleset and return violations with success-criteria references and concrete fixes.

Use this to TEST existing UI (a component's rendered output, a page's source, or generated markup) before shipping.

Args:
  - html (string): the markup to audit.
  - rule_ids (string[], optional): restrict to specific rules; omit to run all.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): default 'markdown'.

Returns (json): { summary: { total, byImpact, rulesChecked, passed }, findings: [{ ruleId, title, wcag, level, impact, selector, snippet, detail, fix }] }.

Scope: this is static analysis. It catches missing names, labels, roles, structure, and inline-color contrast, but cannot see computed styles, runtime state, or actual screen-reader output. A clean result is necessary, not sufficient.

html.description: The HTML document or fragment to audit.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a readable report or 'json' for structured findings.

rule_ids.description: Optional subset of rule ids. Available: img-alt, control-label, button-name, link-name, html-lang, heading-order, empty-heading, positive-tabindex, duplicate-id, valid-role, viewport-zoom, aria-hidden-focusable, label-for-target, contrast-inline, role-conflict, placeholder-label, aria-disabled-only, focus-outline-none, aria-idref.

name: a11y_audit_html
title: Audit HTML for accessibility
